description: Convert up to 1000 pre-July-2025 Vietnamese free-text addresses (63 provinces, districts, wards) into the new 2-level structure (34 provinces, wards) in one call. Returns per-row results plus a summary of converted and failed rows. Null, empty or non-string entries do not fail the call: they come back as failed rows (ok:false with an error code) and are counted in summary.failed.

addresses.description: Free-text old addresses (max 1000); null or empty entries become failed rows

name: vn_address_convert_batch
title: Convert many old addresses to new (2025)
